title: Time & Gravity grounding ledger
description: One row per cited source. A claim span on a T page names one or more row ids; tools/check_timegravity_labels.py derives the label each set of rows can carry.

id.description: Page code and a short source tag, e.g. T01-PR1960.

label.description: The highest label this row alone can support.

doi.description: Must resolve in data/folio-citations.cache.json (offline Crossref cache).

collaboration.description: Who did the work; MEASURED needs two distinct values.

kind.description: press rows can never back a claim; preprint rows cap at PROPOSED.

review_by.description: The build fails once this date has passed.

contrasting_audit.description: Required when offline Scite cache shows contrasting > supporting citation statements (AH-8/AH-12): documents what subsequent literature contrasted and why the row's label/scope holds.
